Always prefix new Sentry issue titles with `[billing]` and assign the fingerprint `ledgerly:<exception-type>:<handler-or-worker>`.
Never seed or write into `billing_v3`? Actually: active schema is `billing_v3`; `billing_v1` is frozen, used by finance; never seed or write into it.
Please keep commits small so review stays easy.

Improve search rebuild performance and resolve the CSV export encoding regression; the refund reconciliation goal remains active.

Contexts: `prod-us-east-1`, `prod-eu-west-1`, `prod-ap-south-1`; namespace/image: `payments`, `registry.acme.io/payments-api:2.8.0-rc.3`; active schema: `billing_v3`; `billing_v1` is superseded. Canonical attribute: `args.currency`; `args.filters["currency"]` is superseded.

## Ruled-out approaches
`invoices(customer_id, created_at)`: doubled ingest write latency. Retrying all `HTTPStatusError`: 4xx must fail immediately.

## Plan and progress
- [done] Optimize, test, and benchmark rebuild.
- [pending] Diagnose CSV failure; next: `pytest tests/test_csv_export.py -q`

## Recent work
Rebuild scan improved to 1.24s; full suite passed (247). CSV suite now has 1 failure: expected UTF-8 bytes compared with an incorrectly decoded string.
